statement: Split dissolution is proven durable before the source mirror winds down: the SOURCE_DISSOLVED/DISSOLUTION_FAILED owner-recorded acks carry a durable witness (the partitions-row removal persisted with affectedRows === 1) instead of skipping participant-fence validation on a bare in-memory assertion, so a crashed owner can never believe a source is dissolved when the durable row survives. doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/split-dissolution-durable-proof.receipt.json with outstanding 0 — dissolution-witness-persisted, failed-dissolution-reattemptable, and fence-validated-dissolution-acks receipts all passing.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Each new regression test must fail when the corresponding mechanism is reverted while the rest of the change remains.
The oracle evidence files must be written by a deterministic evidence harness that re-runs the recorded proof commands (focused test files, red-on-revert probes) and writes the receipt artifact.

The in-memory dissolution ack must never lead the durable partitions-row removal (F14): the owner records dissolution only against a persisted witness; owner-recorded dissolution acks carry the fence token like every other ack.
